results.content:
Optimizely Personalization segments visitors using rules like device type, referral source, behavior, location, and audience attributes to dynamically adapt the on-site experience. It’s built to optimize conversion across inbound traffic at scale.

GenPage works from known intent instead. That could be a named B2B prospect in an outbound sequence, a target account in an ABM campaign, or a Google Ads visitor with clear keyword intent. Instead of adapting an existing experience after someone arrives, GenPage generates a personalized landing page upfront - using AI, your brand context, relevant content, and audience-specific context to create a page tailored to who you’re trying to convert.

The implementation complexity is real - and ongoing.
